title: Injustice: Gods Among Us Ultimate Edition
provenance: Reported by udance4ever (highball-db#934, 2026-11-03), Apple M1, macOS 27.2, Highball 0.10.24, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r29, D3DMetal, rated 3 of 5 after 12 minutes: a steady 60 fps, but when a cutscene hands over to a fight the picture freezes for a few seconds and every sound effect then echoes until the next cutscene. The first launch from ES-DE showed about 45 seconds of black before the first logo, later ones 17 to 18 seconds. Not verified by the maintainer.
notes: Reported playable on an M1 with D3DMetal at a steady 60 fps, with the sound effects echoing during fights.

knownIssues.symptom: Sound effects echo heavily from the moment a cutscene hands over to a fight until the next cutscene, after a freeze of a few seconds at the hand-over (M1, D3DMetal, Wine 10 r29)
knownIssues.fix: none known, besides playing with the sound off
